name: Elam Hutchins
summary: Elam Hutchins was a Dunwich neighbor whose collie Jack was shot by young Wilbur Whateley after the dog tried to bite him, prompting Elam's threat to kill the boy if he dared.
description: According to Wilbur Whateley's diary, Elam Hutchins's collie Jack tried to bite the young Wilbur, who shot the dog; Elam responded that he would kill Wilbur if he dared.

sources.quote: Shot Elam Hutchins's collie Jack when he went to bite me, and Elam says he would kill me if he dast.

facts: His collie Jack tried to bite Wilbur Whateley and was shot by him.
He said he would kill Wilbur if he dared.
